documents.title: Returns and exchanges
documents.content: Unopened products may be returned within 30 days of purchase with the original receipt. Opened products may be exchanged within 14 days only when defective. Final-sale items cannot be returned.

documents.title: Standard shipping
documents.content: Standard shipping within Canada takes three to five business days. Orders over 75 dollars qualify for free standard shipping. Oversized products may have an additional delivery charge shown before checkout.

documents.title: Price match policy
documents.content: A price match is available for an identical in-stock product sold by a Canadian retailer. The request must be made within seven days of purchase. Marketplace sellers and clearance prices are excluded.

documents.title: NorthPeak Aluminum Snow Shovel
documents.content: The NorthPeak Aluminum Snow Shovel costs 39.99 dollars. Its lightweight aluminum blade and ergonomic grip are designed for clearing walkways and small driveways.

documents.title: ArcticPro Wide Snow Shovel
documents.content: The ArcticPro Wide Snow Shovel costs 64.99 dollars. Its wide polymer blade moves deep snow quickly and the reinforced handle suits larger driveways.

documents.title: EcoGrip Ice Melt 10 kg
documents.content: EcoGrip Ice Melt costs 24.50 dollars for a 10 kilogram bag. It is formulated for sidewalks and works to minus 20 degrees Celsius when applied as directed.

documents.title: Thermal Work Gloves
documents.content: Thermal Work Gloves cost 19.99 dollars. The water-resistant shell and insulated lining are intended for outdoor winter chores.
